title: Hairy Kiselev black hole with quintessential matter: themodynamic properties, sparsity of Hawking radiation, and greybody factors
summary: In this work, we investigate the thermodynamic properties, Hawking-radiation sparsity, and greybody-factor bounds of a hairy Kiselev black hole surrounded by a quintessential fluid. The spacetime geometry contains, in addition to the Schwarzschild mass term, a quintessence contribution controlled by the intensity parameter $N$ and the state parameter $ω_q$, an exponential hair correction governed by the coupling $α$ and the primary hair scale $\ell$, and a cosmological constant $Λ$.
